winterCamp.title: Blackmon Tutoring Winter Camp 2026–2027
winterCamp.tagline: Where Winter Break Becomes an Adventure.
winterCamp.intro: Give your child a winter break filled with exciting activities, hands-on learning, creative exploration, and new friendships. From STEM experiments and arts and crafts to sports, games, and field trips, Blackmon Tutoring Winter Camp gives children opportunities to explore new interests, stay engaged, and enjoy meaningful experiences beyond the screen.

sports.intro: Sports offer children another way to stay active, practice coordination, work with others, and discover activities they enjoy.

list.name: Golf
list.text: Explore putting, focus, and hand-eye coordination.

list.text: Enjoy team play, passing, and shooting challenges.

list.name: Soccer
list.text: Enjoy ball skills, movement, and team challenges.

sports.included: All seven sports are included in Premium. Standard includes sports only when you choose the sports option instead of lunch. Basic does not include organized sports.
sports.note: Specific sports, activities, and field-trip participation depend on the final camp schedule and age-appropriate arrangements.

packageNotes: Full camp covers all 8 operating days. The weekly option covers any 5 selected operating days, subject to availability.
Holiday closures are December 25 and January 1.
Optional transportation and extended care are separate from the package price.
winterCamp.lunchNote: With lunch, you can review the menu and choose your child's meal preferences in advance. If your child has food allergies or dietary restrictions, tell our team so suitable arrangements can be discussed before camp.
